# Ibrahim Fawaz Araji — Author & Book Publisher
# https://ibrahimaraji.com (placeholder until domain is registered)

## About This Site
This is the official website of Ibrahim Fawaz Araji, an acclaimed Arab author and publisher
based in Beirut, Lebanon. The site showcases his published works, provides biographical
information, and allows readers and media professionals to get in touch.

## Key Entities

### Person
- Name: Ibrahim Fawaz Araji
- Role: Author, Publisher
- Email: bonahid@araji.com
- Nationality: Lebanese
- Languages: Arabic, English, French
- Specialization: Arabic Literature, Literary Fiction, Historical Fiction, Poetry, Memoir

### Works (10 Published Books)
1. Echoes of the Levant (2018) — Literary Fiction — Three generations of a Lebanese family
2. The Silk Road Diaries (2015) — Historical Fiction — Merchant scholar on ancient trade routes
3. Between Two Rivers (2021) — Historical Fiction — Dual timeline: Babylon and modern Baghdad
4. A Hundred Names for Light (2019) — Literary Fiction — Arab immigrant stories
5. The Philosopher's Garden (2016) — Philosophy — Medieval Andalusia, Ibn Rushd, Maimonides
6. Maps of an Absent Country (2020) — Memoir — Childhood in Lebanon and exile
7. The Calligrapher of Souls (2017) — Literary Fiction — Ottoman Istanbul, sacred calligraphy
8. Desert Songs (2013) — Poetry — Pre-Islamic Mu'allaqat tradition reimagined
9. The Fig Tree and the Fountain (2022) — Cultural Studies — Architecture of Middle Eastern domestic life
10. The Last Muezzin (2023) — Literary Fiction — Syrian city on the eve of conflict
